origin: Arsène awakens as Joker's first Persona during his confrontation with Kamoshida's Shadow. Joker refuses to submit and embraces his rebellious will, causing Arsène to emerge.
At the final confrontation with Yaldabaoth, Joker's rebellion reaches its climax. With the will of the people supporting the Phantom Thieves, Arsène transforms into Satanael.
Raoul is Joker's third Persona, available through Persona 5 Royal's DLC. Unlike the story awakenings, Raoul is not obtained through a new awakening scene in the main story.
Zorro awakens when Morgana accepts his place with the Phantom Thieves and chooses to fight alongside them. His resolve manifests as his first Persona during the escape from Kamoshida's Palace.
Zorro evolves into Mercurius when Morgana's resolve as a Phantom Thief deepens through his Confidant progression. The evolution represents his acceptance of his role and bonds with the group.
Morgana's third-tier Persona, Diego, awakens after he reaches the final stage of his Confidant and reaffirms his resolve and identity as a member of the Phantom Thieves.
Captain Kidd awakens when Ryuji rejects the role Kamoshida forced upon him. By accepting his anger and choosing to rebel against Kamoshida, Ryuji summons Captain Kidd.
Captain Kidd evolves into Seiten Taisei when Ryuji's bond reaches its highest stage. His resolve to move forward rather than remain defined by his past allows his Persona to evolve.
Ryuji's third-tier Persona, William, awakens after he reaches the final stage of his Confidant. Ryuji accepts his past and chooses his own future, causing his Persona to transform again.
Carmen awakens when Ann rejects Kamoshida's control over her life and chooses to stand up for Shiho and herself. Her determination to fight back manifests as Carmen.
Carmen evolves into Hecate when Ann's bond reaches its highest stage. Her confidence and determination to pursue her own path cause her Persona to evolve.
Ann's third-tier Persona, Célestine, awakens after she reaches the final stage of her Confidant and fully commits to her own future and the people she wants to protect.
Goemon awakens when Yusuke confronts Madarame and accepts the truth about his former master. Choosing to expose Madarame's crimes and follow his own artistic path brings forth Goemon.
Goemon evolves into Kamu Susano-o when Yusuke's bond reaches its highest stage. His decision to continue creating art according to his own ideals allows his Persona to evolve.
Yusuke's third-tier Persona, Gorokichi, awakens after he reaches the final stage of his Confidant and resolves to keep moving forward as an artist on his own terms.
Johanna awakens when Makoto stops living only according to the expectations placed on her by others. She chooses to act for herself and protect the people around her, awakening Johanna.
Johanna evolves into Anat when Makoto's bond reaches its highest stage. Her growing confidence and decision to pursue her own path cause her Persona to evolve.
Makoto's third-tier Persona, Agnes, awakens after she reaches the final stage of her Confidant and fully commits to making her own decisions about her future.
Necronomicon awakens inside Futaba's Palace when Futaba confronts the distorted memories and guilt surrounding her mother's death. Accepting the truth allows her to summon her Persona.
Necronomicon evolves into Prometheus as Futaba's bond reaches its highest stage. Futaba gains greater confidence in living independently and supporting the Phantom Thieves.
Futaba's third-tier Persona, Al Azif, awakens after she reaches the final stage of her Confidant and accepts her ability to face the future while remaining connected to others.
Milady awakens when Haru decides to reject the future chosen for her by her father and his company. During the confrontation in Okumura's Palace, she chooses to fight for herself.
Milady evolves into Astarte when Haru's bond reaches its highest stage. Haru's growing independence and determination to build a future of her own allow her Persona to evolve.
Haru's third-tier Persona, Lucy, awakens after she reaches the final stage of her Confidant and commits to living according to her own choices rather than the expectations of others.

Robin Hood is the Persona Akechi presents alongside his identity as the Detective Prince. His Persona situation differs from the other Phantom Thieves because Akechi deliberately maintains a public heroic persona while hiding his true motives.

Loki represents the darker truth behind Akechi's Persona identity. As Akechi's real motives and hatred are revealed, Loki becomes associated with the Persona he uses when he no longer needs to maintain the Robin Hood facade.

Hereward is Akechi's third-tier Persona in Royal. It awakens after Akechi's Confidant reaches its final stage, reflecting his decision to confront the truth about himself and continue acting according to his own will.

Cendrillon awakens when Kasumi accepts her resolve to move forward and fight alongside the Phantom Thieves. Her awakening is tied to the conflict surrounding her identity and her struggle with the expectations she placed on herself.
Cendrillon evolves into Vanadis as Kasumi's bond reaches its highest stage. Her growing confidence and determination allow her to move beyond the identity she had been trying to live up to.

Kasumi's third-tier Persona, Ella, awakens after she reaches the final stage of her Confidant and accepts the truth about herself, allowing her to move forward without being defined by her sister's identity.
